summary_en: Expanded share buyback authorization from 1.5M shares (¥4.0B) to 5.5M shares (13.9% S/O, ¥17.0B). Period extended to 24 May 2027. Method now includes ToSTNeT-3 block trades alongside open-market purchases. As of 30 July 2026, 180K shares acquired for ¥461M under prior authorization.
title_en: Notice on Partial Revision of Matters Related to Treasury Share Acquisition (Expansion of Acquisition Ceiling) – Treasury Share Acquisition Based on Articles of Incorporation Pursuant to Company Law Article 459, Paragraph 1
translation_en_brief: EIZO Corporation announced on 31 July 2026 an expansion of its treasury share acquisition program, originally authorized by the board on 12 May 2026. The company revised the authorization upward from 1.5 million shares (¥4.0 billion) to 5.5 million shares (¥17.0 billion), representing 13.91% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. The execution period was also extended from 30 April 2027 to 24 May 2027. The buyback method now explicitly includes ToSTNeT-3 off-market block trades in addition to open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. As of 30 July 2026, the company had already acquired 180,000 shares for ¥461 million under the initial authorization. The company stated the expansion supports its capital structure objectives—neutralizing volatility from investment securities holdings—and will fund the program through cash on hand and proceeds from securities liquidation. The announcement indicated a medium-term capital policy roadmap will accompany the forthcoming strategic plan, focusing on ROE improvement and enterprise value through dual drivers of profit growth and capital efficiency.
